regions.label: INES_Header
regions.evidence: iNES signature and parsed header fields; inspection verifies 128 KiB PRG, 128 KiB CHR, MMC3 mapper 4.

regions.label: CHR_Tiles
regions.evidence: Header-delimited CHR-ROM backing; NES PPU pattern storage is 8192 16-byte two-bitplane tiles, not CPU executable PRG.

regions.label: CPU_Vectors
regions.evidence: Fixed-bank CPU $FFFA-$FFFF little-endian NMI/reset/IRQ vectors $FA68/$FE00/$E32B; reset runtime agrees.

regions.label: Bank_00_Tag
regions.evidence: Literal ASCII BANK identifier followed by space padding at 16 KiB PRG section boundary; neighboring bytes inspected. Original source/linker marker, no execution claim.

regions.label: Password_Digits
regions.evidence: Six-digit password records: 54 records of six decimal digits between preceding RTS at physical 0x1BAB0 and subsequent routine at 0x1BBF5. Consumer 0x1B952 initializes pointer $BAA1, compares six input digits at RAM $0730, then advances pointer by six. Local 040471 and 745765 accepted via ordinary handler. Extent supported by 54-entry metadata and exact digit-domain boundary; loop scans #$54 (84) records, so its overrun behavior is unresolved and not used as extent proof.
